Mireille Fontaine — CV bullets (Senior Backend Engineer, Payments Platform, Ledgerbridge Financial)

Summary
- Backend engineer since 2014, with production work in Go, Python and Java; the last seven years spent entirely in the payments domain at Harborline Payments and Anchorwell Payments.
- Currently Staff Backend Engineer at Anchorwell Payments, owning the settlement reconciliation service end to end.

Anchorwell Payments — Staff Backend Engineer (Jul 2023 – Present)
- Own the settlement reconciliation service end to end, closing each business day's payment batches across three currencies.
- Rebuilt the reconciliation pipeline from scratch following a 2023 data-loss incident during a database migration; every batch since has processed without a repeat incident.
- Led the migration of the payments ledger from a self-hosted Postgres cluster to a managed, multi-region database service.
- Built on the fraud-signal ingestion path that feeds the risk team's models, working to the risk team's requirements.
- Introduced a canary deployment process for the payments API to de-risk releases on the money-movement path.
- Participate in the org-wide incident response rotation for payment-critical services.

Anchorwell Payments — Senior Backend Engineer (Feb 2021 – Jul 2023)
- Built the idempotency-key service used by the checkout team to prevent duplicate charges.
- Re-architected the payment authorization path, reducing peak-hour checkout latency.
- Served as on-call primary for the payments service for six consecutive quarters — production systems with money on the line.
- Wrote the internal runbook for PCI-DSS scope reduction that the security team adopted; engineering-side compliance work rather than formal audit.
- Informally mentored two mid-level engineers joining the payments team.

Harborline Payments — Backend Engineer (Mar 2018 – Feb 2021)
- Migrated batch settlement jobs from cron scripts to an Airflow-based pipeline.
- Implemented retry and backoff logic for failed card-network calls.
- Investigated and fixed a currency-conversion rounding error that had gone unnoticed for several months.
- Worked on the merchant onboarding API alongside the platform team, and added test coverage to the refund processing service.
- Presented the settlement pipeline redesign at the company's internal quarterly engineering demo.

Voss Analytics — Software Engineer (Aug 2015 – Feb 2018)
- Built nightly ETL jobs loading client usage data into a reporting warehouse, and wrote the first version of the internal API behind the analytics dashboard.
- Performance-tuned slow SQL reports for the customer success team; helped set up the team's first CI pipeline in Jenkins.
- Provided on-call coverage for the reporting service during quarterly close.

Kestrel Digital — Junior Developer (Jul 2014 – Jul 2015)
- Built internal Python tooling for the operations team and documented the internal deployment process.

Technical notes
- Production languages: Go, Python, Java. Messaging in production at both Harborline and Anchorwell was via a managed queue service (no self-run Kafka cluster experience).
- Domain: card-network integration, authorization, refunds, settlement and reconciliation, idempotency, PCI-DSS scope reduction.
- Team context: all employers to date have had engineering organisations of under 200 people.

job.raw_text:
Senior Backend Engineer, Payments Platform
Ledgerbridge Financial - Remote (UK/EU)

About Ledgerbridge

Ledgerbridge Financial builds settlement infrastructure for mid-sized merchants across
Europe. We process a lot of money on behalf of businesses who need to trust that it
moves correctly, every time. Our platform team owns everything from card-network
integration to nightly settlement, and we're growing it.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Payments Platform team. You'll
work on the systems that move money between merchants, card networks, and banks, and
you'll be one of the people the rest of engineering leans on when a payment doesn't
reconcile. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management track.

What you'll do

- Design and build services in the core settlement and reconciliation path
- Take ownership of at least one production service end to end
- Be part of the on-call rotation for payment-critical systems
- Work closely with the risk and compliance teams on how we handle sensitive data
- Help less experienced engineers on the team grow

What you'll need

- 5+ years building backend services in Go, Java, or a similar statically typed language
- Experience with Kafka or a comparable message broker in production
- Familiarity with PCI-DSS or a similar compliance framework, even if you weren't the
  one formally responsible for it
- On-call experience for production systems where money is on the line
- Experience mentoring other engineers
- A strong communicator who can explain a tricky bug to someone outside the team

Nice to have

- Prior experience at a fintech, payments, or banking company
- Rust experience
- Experience managing a team's infrastructure or cloud budget
- Conference speaking experience
- Comfortable working in a company with 200+ engineers

Benefits & perks

Competitive salary and equity, private health cover, 28 days holiday plus bank
holidays, a home office stipend, and a genuinely flexible remote-first culture.
Ledgerbridge Financial is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants
regardless of background.
